background.title: Company Background
paragraphs: Singapore Math Wizard was founded in 2020 by Ms. Kym, an experienced tuition center teacher, and has grown into a leading provider of Singapore Math education.

Driven by a passion for children's learning, Ms. Kym set out to unlock every child's potential in math through personalized instruction and a dynamic learning environment. Our program follows the renowned Singapore Math curriculum, tailored to each student's learning style.
Our young, energetic teachers bring creativity to every lesson. Trusted by parents and students alike, we strive for excellence in math education, and we invite you to join us on this journey.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To ignite a math revolution, transforming the way students perceive and conquer mathematics with the power of Singapore Math.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To unleash the math wizard within every student. Igniting a love for math, boosting confidence, and empowering students to become fearless problem solvers through captivating Singapore Math lessons and innovative teaching methods.

items.title: Excellence
items.text: We strive for excellence in everything we do, from the quality of our teaching to the resources we provide.

items.title: Innovation

items.title: Personalization
items.text: We understand that every student is unique, and we tailor our instruction to meet the individual needs and learning styles of each student.

items.title: Passion

items.title: Growth mindset
items.text: We promote a growth mindset in our students, encouraging them to embrace challenges, persist in the face of obstacles, and believe in their ability to learn and improve.

items.title: Collaboration
items.text: We value collaboration between students, parents, and teachers. We actively engage parents in their child's learning journey, providing regular updates, feedback, and guidance.

items.title: Empowerment

items.title: Fun and engagement

intro: In P3, your child will expand their problem-solving toolbox by learning heuristics, such as drawing diagrams and looking for patterns.
If your child’s foundation is weak, they will struggle. Soon, they dread doing their homework or going to class.
They are afraid that they can’t keep up.
With Practicle, they can!
First, our platform will use AI to personalise our questions to match your child’s current ability.
Then, over time, as your child improves, we’ll give them tougher questions.
Even if the class has moved on, they can continue to build their skills.
That’s the beauty of self-paced learning.
Our syllabus is 100% aligned with MOE and is certified by the Education Alliance of Finland (EAF) for educational quality and effectiveness.

items.q: Which primary levels do you offer for online classes?
a: We offer online classes for primary levels ranging from Primary 1 to Primary 6.

items.q: What kind of math syllabus do you offer?
a: We offer Singapore Math syllabus that is aligned with Singapore MOE's curriculum, which is widely recognized for its effectiveness in developing strong mathematical foundations and problem-solving skills.

items.q: Which platform do you use to conduct online classes?
a: We conduct our online classes by using the popular and reliable video conferencing platform - ZOOM.

items.q: What are the qualifications of your online tutors?
a: Our online tutors hold at least a bachelor's degree and have undergone comprehensive training on Singapore Math to provide creative teaching methods with various online tools.

items.q: Which language is used during the online classes?
a: Classes are conducted primarily in English, but we will provide Chinese translation to SJKC students specifically.

items.q: My child is studying in SJK(C) or SK under the Malaysian government syllabus (KSSR). Will it conflict with the existing curriculum in school?
a: No. Singapore Math syllabus is designed to complement and enhance the existing curriculum in schools. We focus on building strong mathematical foundations and problem-solving skills.

items.q: Singapore Math vs Olympiad Math - How are they different?
a: Singapore Math is a comprehensive curriculum that focuses on building a solid foundation in essential mathematical concepts and problem-solving skills. It aims to provide a well-rounded mathematical education for students.
Olympiad Math is a specialized program that prepares students for mathematical Olympiad competitions. It focuses on creative thinking and exploring multiple approaches to solving complex IQ problems.

items.q: Singapore Math vs Kumon - How are they different?
a: Singapore Math covers a wide range of mathematical topics while emphasizing conceptual understanding, problem-solving skills, and the use of visual models.
Kumon uses repetitive practice worksheets to reinforce math skills while developing speed and accuracy.

items.q: Can I schedule a free introduction session before joining the online classes?
a: Absolutely! Feel free to reach out to us through {email} or {call}.

items.q: What is the tuition fee structure for online classes?
a: You may view it through this {pricing}.

items.q: Can I request to change the day and time for weekly classes?
a: Yes! You may discuss with your assigned teacher or contact us through {email} or {call} for further arrangements.

items.q: What if I can't attend the online classes?
a: For our 1-to-1 learning class, you may discuss and reschedule with your assigned teacher.

For our peer learning class, kindly give us at least 2-3 days advance notice for further rearrangements with other parents. In the event that you are unable to give us advance notice, don't worry! We will provide you with a recording of the missed session so you can catch up on the material at your convenience.

items.q: How to ensure the effectiveness of online classes?
a: Tutors and students are required to keep their cameras turned on throughout the session. This helps us to create an interactive and engaging learning environment, as our experienced tutors can actively observe and provide personalized guidance based on students' responses and participation.

items.q: Is there any homework assigned after each online class?
a: Yes! In order to reinforce the concepts covered during the class, we will assign homework after each session through Practicle app.

items.q: How can parents track their child's progress during the class?
a: Our teachers will actively communicate with parents to provide regular updates on their child's performance. We believe in maintaining a strong parent-teacher partnership to ensure the best educational outcomes for our students.

items.q: What is Practicle?
a: Practicle is a fun gamified online math learning app associated with our online classes. The app has been endorsed by Education Alliance of Finland for educational quality and effectiveness.

items.q: What device does Practicle work on?
a: Practicle is a browser-based app that works well with Google Chrome and Firefox, except Safari.
It is compatible with desktops, laptops, tablets, and mobile phones, as long as there is Internet connection.

items.q: What kind of Math questions can I expect my child to be doing on Practicle?
a: Your child will get a nice balance of multiple-choice questions, short-answer questions, and word problems.
Practicle has questions for all levels and abilities where the system will choose the perfect difficulty for your child to progressively improve their math skills over time!

items.q: Are the Math questions updated?
a: Yes! Practicle will update its question bank every school term, so your child will get a variety of questions that follow exam trends.

items.q: Are there answers for every question?
a: Yes! Every question in Practicle will come with 2 kinds of answers:
1. Step-by-step written explanations
2. Video explanations

items.q: Can I review past mistakes?
a: Yes. Every question you've done is stored in your Practicle account and you can review them anytime along with their worked solutions and video explanations.

items.q: How do I make a payment?

**Paid Plans**
Simply enter your payment information during registration like you would with most online purchases. We accept internet bank transfer, credit cards and debit cards.

items.q: Are there any deposit/registration fees?
a: No. Choose a plan and sign up now!

items.q: Can I change/cancel my subscription anytime?
a: Yes. You can change/cancel your subscription anytime within our system or contact us through {email} or {call}.
